subject: FY2023 City Budget Crisis and Structural Deficit
overview: The Council received a detailed presentation from Vice President Bears outlining a structural deficit in the city budget and the impact of inaccurate ARPA revenue assumptions. Councilors engaged in a lengthy debate regarding fiscal transparency and the administration's communication during the budget process.

items.title: Petition for Zoning Amendment: 222-236 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Referred to the Community Development Board a petition to change the zoning designation from industrial to office two for a proposed life science development.

items.title: FY2023 City Budget Review and Presentation
items.summary: Received and placed on file a presentation by Vice President Bears regarding a $29 million structural deficit and $5 million in last-minute budget cuts resulting from miscalculated ARPA revenue. Councilors expressed frustration with a lack of quarterly financial reports and the administration's reliance on one-time revenues to fund recurring costs.

items.title: Approval of Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the Committee of the Whole reports regarding the budget meetings held on June 7 and June 8, 2022.

items.title: Affordable Housing Lottery Preference for Employees
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a legal report on establishing affordable housing lottery preferences for city employees and retirees.

items.title: Rockwell Terrace and Fulton Street Infrastructure
items.summary: Approved a request to include crosswalk and curbing restoration at the corner of Rockwell Terrace and Fulton Street in the Gillis Park accessibility project.

items.title: Medford Square Parking Needs
items.summary: Approved an invitation to the Medford Chamber of Commerce to discuss the potential for a parking garage in Medford Square.

items.title: Inaccurate 'Town Hall Guide' Mailing
items.summary: Approved a resolution to notify residents that a mailing from 'Town Hall Guide' was not an official city document and contained incorrect emergency contact information.

items.title: Public Participation: Cabot Road and Sydney Street Sidewalks
items.summary: Tabled a request for sidewalk repairs as the petitioner was not present to speak.

items.title: MBTA Bus Network Redesign
items.summary: Approved a request for the MBTA to hold an in-person meeting regarding the impact of the bus network redesign on the inner core. Residents raised concerns about the elimination of the 80 bus and changes to the 94 and 96 lines.

items.title: Approval of Records and General Public Participation
items.summary: Approved meeting records and heard comments regarding the lack of official recognition for Flag Day.
